controls.title: Policies for information security
controls.description: Information security policy and topic-specific policies shall be defined, approved by management, published, communicated and reviewed.

controls.title: Information security roles and responsibilities
controls.description: Information security roles and responsibilities shall be defined and allocated according to organizational needs.

controls.title: Segregation of duties
controls.description: Conflicting duties and conflicting areas of responsibility shall be segregated.

controls.title: Management responsibilities
controls.description: Management shall require all personnel to apply information security in accordance with the established policy.

controls.title: Contact with authorities
controls.description: The organization shall establish and maintain contact with relevant authorities.

controls.title: Contact with special interest groups
controls.description: The organization shall establish and maintain contact with special interest groups.

controls.title: Threat intelligence
controls.description: Information relating to information security threats shall be collected and analyzed.

controls.title: Information security in project management
controls.description: Information security shall be integrated into project management.

controls.title: Inventory of information and other associated assets
controls.description: An inventory of information and other associated assets shall be developed and maintained.

controls.title: Acceptable use of information and other associated assets
controls.description: Rules for the acceptable use shall be identified, documented and implemented.

controls.title: Return of assets
controls.description: Personnel shall return all organizational assets upon change or termination.

controls.title: Classification of information
controls.description: Information shall be classified according to confidentiality, integrity, availability requirements.

controls.title: Labelling of information
controls.description: An appropriate set of procedures for information labelling shall be developed.

controls.title: Information transfer
controls.description: Information transfer rules, procedures or agreements shall be in place.

controls.title: Access control
controls.description: Rules to control physical and logical access shall be established and implemented.

controls.title: Identity management
controls.description: The full life cycle of identities shall be managed.

controls.title: Authentication information
controls.description: Allocation and management of authentication information shall be controlled by a management process.

controls.title: Access rights
controls.description: Access rights shall be provisioned, reviewed, modified and removed.

controls.title: Information security in supplier relationships
controls.description: Processes shall be defined to manage information security risks associated with the use of suppliers.

controls.title: Addressing information security in supplier agreements
controls.description: Relevant information security requirements shall be established and agreed with each supplier.

controls.title: Managing information security in the ICT supply chain
controls.description: Processes shall be defined to manage ICT supply chain risks.

controls.title: Monitoring, review and change management of supplier services
controls.description: Changes to supplier services shall be regularly monitored, reviewed and managed.

controls.title: Information security for use of cloud services
controls.description: Processes for acquisition, use, management and exit of cloud services shall be established.

controls.title: Information security incident management planning and preparation
controls.description: Processes for incident management shall be established and documented.

controls.title: Assessment and decision on information security events
controls.description: Information security events shall be assessed and decisions made on classification.

controls.title: Response to information security incidents
controls.description: Information security incidents shall be responded to in accordance with documented procedures.

controls.title: Learning from information security incidents
controls.description: Knowledge gained from incidents shall be used to strengthen security controls.

controls.title: Collection of evidence
controls.description: Procedures for evidence collection shall be established and implemented.

controls.title: Information security during disruption
controls.description: Information security shall be maintained at appropriate levels during disruption.

controls.title: ICT readiness for business continuity
controls.description: ICT readiness shall be planned, implemented, maintained and tested.

controls.title: Legal, statutory, regulatory and contractual requirements
controls.description: Relevant requirements shall be identified, documented and kept up to date.

controls.title: Intellectual property rights
controls.description: Procedures for intellectual property rights shall be implemented.

controls.title: Protection of records
controls.description: Records shall be protected from loss, destruction, falsification, unauthorized access.

controls.title: Privacy and protection of PII
controls.description: The organization shall identify and meet requirements regarding PII protection.

controls.title: Independent review of information security
controls.description: The approach shall be reviewed independently at planned intervals.

controls.title: Compliance with policies, rules and standards
controls.description: Compliance with policies shall be regularly reviewed.

controls.title: Documented operating procedures
controls.description: Operating procedures for information processing facilities shall be documented and made available.

controls.title: Screening
controls.description: Background verification checks shall be carried out on all candidates.

controls.title: Terms and conditions of employment
controls.description: Employment contracts shall state security responsibilities.

controls.title: Information security awareness, education and training
controls.description: Personnel shall receive appropriate awareness training.

controls.title: Disciplinary process
controls.description: A disciplinary process for security violations shall be formalized.

controls.title: Responsibilities after termination or change of employment
controls.description: Security responsibilities that remain valid after termination shall be defined.

controls.title: Confidentiality or non-disclosure agreements
controls.description: NDAs reflecting the organization's needs shall be identified, documented, regularly reviewed and signed.

controls.title: Remote working
controls.description: Security measures shall be implemented to protect information accessed from remote locations.

controls.title: Information security event reporting
controls.description: A mechanism to report information security events shall be provided.

controls.title: Physical security perimeters
controls.description: Security perimeters shall be defined and used to protect areas with sensitive information.

controls.title: Physical entry
controls.description: Secure areas shall be protected by appropriate entry controls and access points.

controls.title: Securing offices, rooms and facilities
controls.description: Physical security for offices, rooms and facilities shall be designed and applied.

controls.title: Physical security monitoring
controls.description: Premises shall be continuously monitored for unauthorized physical access.

controls.title: Protecting against physical and environmental threats
controls.description: Protection against environmental threats shall be designed and applied.

controls.title: Working in secure areas
controls.description: Procedures for working in secure areas shall be designed and applied.

controls.title: Clear desk and clear screen
controls.description: Clear desk and clear screen rules shall be defined.

controls.title: Equipment siting and protection
controls.description: Equipment shall be sited securely and protected.

controls.title: Security of assets off-premises
controls.description: Off-site assets shall be protected.

controls.title: Storage media
controls.description: Storage media shall be managed through their life cycle.

controls.title: Supporting utilities
controls.description: Information processing facilities shall be protected from power failures and other disruptions.

controls.title: Cabling security
controls.description: Power and telecommunications cabling shall be protected from interception.

controls.title: Equipment maintenance
controls.description: Equipment shall be maintained correctly to ensure continued availability and integrity.

controls.title: Secure disposal or re-use of equipment
controls.description: Items of equipment containing storage media shall be verified before disposal.

controls.title: User end point devices
controls.description: Information stored on, processed by or accessible via user endpoint devices shall be protected.

controls.title: Privileged access rights
controls.description: The allocation and use of privileged access rights shall be restricted and managed.

controls.title: Information access restriction
controls.description: Access to information shall be restricted in accordance with policy.

controls.title: Access to source code
controls.description: Read and write access to source code shall be appropriately managed.

controls.title: Secure authentication
controls.description: Secure authentication technologies and procedures shall be implemented.

controls.title: Capacity management
controls.description: Resource use shall be monitored and adjusted in line with current and expected capacity requirements.

controls.title: Protection against malware
controls.description: Protection against malware shall be implemented.

controls.title: Management of technical vulnerabilities
controls.description: Information about technical vulnerabilities shall be obtained, exposure evaluated, measures taken.

controls.title: Configuration management
controls.description: Configurations of hardware, software, services and networks shall be established, documented and reviewed.

controls.title: Information deletion
controls.description: Information stored in systems shall be deleted when no longer required.

controls.title: Data masking
controls.description: Data masking shall be used in accordance with the topic-specific access control policy.

controls.title: Data leakage prevention
controls.description: Data leakage prevention measures shall be applied to systems, networks, and devices.

controls.title: Information backup
controls.description: Backup copies shall be maintained and regularly tested.

controls.title: Redundancy of information processing facilities
controls.description: Information processing facilities shall be implemented with redundancy.

controls.title: Logging
controls.description: Logs that record activities, exceptions, faults shall be produced, stored, protected and analyzed.

controls.title: Monitoring activities
controls.description: Networks, systems and applications shall be monitored for anomalous behaviour.

controls.title: Clock synchronization
controls.description: The clocks of information processing systems shall be synchronized.

controls.title: Use of privileged utility programs
controls.description: The use of utility programs that may override system controls shall be restricted.

controls.title: Installation of software on operational systems
controls.description: Procedures shall be implemented to control software installation on operational systems.

controls.title: Networks security
controls.description: Networks shall be managed and controlled to protect information.

controls.title: Security of network services
controls.description: Security mechanisms, service levels and requirements of network services shall be identified.

controls.title: Segregation of networks
controls.description: Groups of information services, users and information systems shall be segregated.

controls.title: Web filtering
controls.description: Access to external websites shall be managed.

controls.title: Use of cryptography
controls.description: Rules for the effective use of cryptography shall be defined and implemented.

controls.title: Secure development life cycle
controls.description: Rules for the secure development of software and systems shall be established.

controls.title: Application security requirements
controls.description: Information security requirements shall be identified, specified and approved.

controls.title: Secure system architecture and engineering principles
controls.description: Principles for secure system engineering shall be established.

controls.title: Secure coding
controls.description: Secure coding principles shall be applied to software development.

controls.title: Security testing in development and acceptance
controls.description: Security testing processes shall be defined and implemented.

controls.title: Outsourced development
controls.description: The organization shall direct, monitor and review activities related to outsourced system development.

controls.title: Separation of development, test and production environments
controls.description: Development, testing and production environments shall be separated and secured.

controls.title: Change management
controls.description: Changes to information processing facilities and systems shall be subject to change management procedures.

controls.title: Test information
controls.description: Test information shall be appropriately selected, protected and managed.

controls.title: Protection of information systems during audit testing
controls.description: Audit tests shall be carefully planned to minimize disruption.
